About Taxzentic

Making GST compliance simpler for every Indian business — free, instant, and always accurate.

Our Mission

Taxzentic was built with a simple goal: to give every Indian business owner, accountant, and taxpayer access to free, accurate, and instant GST tools — without requiring a login, subscription, or internet connection for calculations.

India's GST system, while transformative, can be complex. With multiple tax slabs, thousands of HSN/SAC codes, and strict GSTIN format requirements, even experienced professionals sometimes need a quick reference. We built these tools to be that reference.

Our Editorial & Verification Process

Meet our CA Review Board →

Every tool, calculator algorithm, and article on Taxzentic is reviewed by qualified Chartered Accountants and verified against official notifications:

1
Research & Source Verification

All GST rates, thresholds, and rules are cross-referenced against official CBIC notifications, GST Council press releases, and the Finance Act text.

2
Expert-Verified Content

Calculator formulas and compliance guidance are researched by our editorial team and verified against official CBIC/CBDT notifications and government circulars.

3
Regular Updates Within 48 Hours

Content is refreshed immediately following GST Council meetings or Union Budget amendments. Each page displays a "Last updated" date for complete transparency.

What We Offer

25+ free tools covering every aspect of GST compliance — from basic calculations to advanced reconciliation and validation.

GST Calculator

Add or remove GST with CGST/SGST split. Supports all slabs and custom rates.

HSN Code Lookup

Search 100+ HSN and SAC codes with GST rates. Instant offline filtering.

GSTIN Validator

Validate GSTIN format and checksum. Decodes state and PAN offline.

Our Principles

Privacy First

All calculations happen in your browser. No data is sent to our servers — ever.

Instant Results

No loading spinners, no API calls. Results appear as you type.

Mobile Friendly

Fully responsive design optimized for thumb-friendly mobile use.

Accessible

Built with WCAG accessibility guidelines including screen reader support.

Always Free

No paywalls, no premium tiers, no "unlock" gates. All tools are free forever.

Open & Transparent

We show our formulas, cite our sources, and display update dates on every page.

Disclaimer

Taxzentic is an independent informational website. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Government of India, CBIC, or the GST Council. All GST rates and information are provided for reference only and may not reflect the latest government notifications.

For official GST information, always refer to gst.gov.in and cbic.gov.in.

Get in Touch

Have a suggestion, found an error, or want to contribute to our HSN dataset? We'd love to hear from you. Contact us here.

Client-Side Privacy

All computations run locally inside your browser. No financial data or GSTIN records are ever sent to our servers.

Statutory Accuracy

Formulas and thresholds updated against official CBIC notifications, GST 2.0 slabs, and Union Budget provisions.

Free & Offline PWA
